name: GRAMMER Offroad Intelligence Relationship Rules
purpose: Defines how intelligence objects should connect and propagate across the Offroad Intelligence Hub.

rules.description: Every evidence item should preserve where it came from.
Signals should reference the evidence that supports them.
Trends are formed from repeated or clustered signals.
Assessments should reference the underlying signals.
Assessments may generate or support opportunities.
Assessments may generate or support risks.
Opportunities and risks should lead to function-specific actions where relevant.
Actions should be closed with outcomes where possible.

propagationRules.description: themeIds should propagate from evidence or signals to assessments, opportunities, risks, actions and outcomes where the link remains relevant.
customerIds, competitorIds and technologyIds should propagate from signals to assessments and downstream opportunity/risk/action objects when applicable.
Confidence should not increase automatically downstream unless additional evidence or validation is added.
Pages should read linked objects from the network rather than storing duplicate page-specific intelligence.

confidenceGuidance.Low: Single source, weak reliability, unclear implication or early weak signal.
confidenceGuidance.Medium: Multiple indicators or one reliable source with plausible business implication.
confidenceGuidance.High: Multiple reliable sources, corroborated pattern or analyst-validated implication.
